rows.en:
The AI operator we're using this time is
Staff Officer Exsedol Folmo
of the Macross 7 fleet.
rows.notes: sanbou = staff officer (title, not in ranks glossary).

rows.en: All right, let's get the stunt started.
Then I guess I'll ask Michel to play Ivanov.

(I can't let my guard down just because
it's a stunt. I've gotta do this right!)
Wow... the sea on Island 3 really is beautiful.
I know, Michel-kun.

Still, Mihoshi Academy and S.M.S. helping
film the stunts for a movie...
That's pretty incredible.

Huh, really?
So what kind of Valkyrie are they using
for the shoot?

(Uh-oh, Luca-kun's started one of his
long explanations...)
Got it.
Do the stunt with Saotome-kun
Do the stunt with Michel-kun
Then I guess I'll ask Saotome-kun to play Ivanov.
As if I would.
Then I guess I'll ask Michel-kun to play Ivanov.

(I can't let my guard down just because
it's a stunt. I've got to do this right!)
(Oh no, that stunt was a total failure.)

Jeez, you can't even pull off a decent stunt?
Swap roles with Michel.

(Sigh...
Next time, I've gotta try harder so I don't
drag everyone down...)
(That should work fine as a stunt.)

You're better than I expected.
Those weren't bad moves at all.
Thanks, Alto.

My mistake for casting you as Focker.
Sorry, but swap with Alto.

Huh, not bad.
Let's knock out the next shoot at this pace too.
Right, Michel.

That's it for today's filming, apparently.
Thanks for sticking it out this late.

That said, there's more filming next week.
I'm counting on you again, \p.
(Phew, it's finally over...)

(Aww, man... I even bought a new swimsuit,
and I didn't get any time to play at all...)

(Looks like there's more filming next week,
so I hope that this time I'll finally get to
have fun at the beach with everyone.)

(Of course, that means I've gotta give
the stunts my all!)
(Oh no, that stunt was a total failure.)
(That should work fine as a stunt.)
Right, Michel-kun.
(Phew, it's finally over...)

(Aww... I even bought a new swimsuit,
and I didn't get any time to play at all...)

(Of course, that means I've got to give
the stunts my all!)

(All right! I'm gonna give the movie stunts
my all this week too! I'll finish early
and go play at the beach!!)

Yahooooo!!!
All riiight!! This sea is all mine!!

Hold it, Hoshimura!
It's dangerous to go in without
warming up properly first!
Huh?! What?

Honestly... you two are getting way too
excited just because you can play at the beach...

Huh? Why are you three in swimsuits,
getting ready to play?

Oh, \p-kun.
Our group's already done filming,
so we were told we're free to do as we like.

Well then, \p-kun, you and the others
keep up the good work helping out
with the filming, okay?

(I'm gonna play at the beach too,
no matter what!)

Today's stunt is for what you could call
the climactic scene of this movie.
The part where Shin goes to rescue Sara, right?

Yeah, that's the one.
I'm thinking I want you to play Shin.
No problem with that, right?
Yeah, leave it to me.

Then I'm counting on you.
That just leaves Focker, Shin's partner...

He's your partner, after all.
Me or Alto, which one do you want to
team up with? You pick.
Team up with Alto
Team up with Michel
I think I'll pick Alto as my partner.

The obvious choice.
Let's leave Michel crying in our dust.
rows.notes: hoezura kakaseru = make someone cry in defeat.

rows.en: Ooh, scary. That's Princess Alto for you.
All right, let's get right to the shoot.
I think I'll pick Michel as my partner.

The obvious choice.
Let's have a little fun with Princess Alto.

Michel...! You're the one who'll be crying,
you bastard!

Yeah, yeah.
All right, let's get right to the shoot.

(All right! I'm gonna do my best so we get
a dogfight scene that feels totally real!)

(All right! I've got to give the movie stunts
my all this week too! I'll finish early
and go play at the beach!!)

Oh, \p-san.
Our group's already done filming,
so we were told we're free to do as we like.
O-oh, I see...

Well then, \p-san, you and the others
keep up the good work helping out
with the filming, okay?

(I'm going to play at the beach too,
no matter what!)
The part where Shin goes to rescue Sara, right?
Team up with Saotome-kun
Team up with Michel-kun
I think I'll pick Saotome-kun as my partner.
I think I'll pick Michel-kun as my partner.

(All right! I'm going to do my best so we get
a dogfight scene that feels totally real!)
Jeez, can't you even pull off a decent stunt?

Jeez, come on, get it together.
Guess Shin was too big a role for you
after all...

(Phew, that about wraps up my part
in the movie shoot.)

(It was tough, but I got to have a pretty
rare experience, and it was fun.)
(And now, finally, the beach...!)
(Hm?)

uncertain: c23610: Exsedol's title sanbou rendered 'Staff Officer' (no glossary entry for this title).
c23670: Alto's kisama rendered 'you bastard' (full strength, rivalry banter with Michel).
